title: Ndolé, Cameroonian Bitter Leaf Stew (Eat Well Abi)
author: Abi Olayiwola (Eat Well Abi)
desc: Blended peanuts, ginger, garlic, onion and Scotch bonnet simmered with ground crayfish, finished with spinach and bitter leaf and topped with fried prawns and onions.
longDesc: A lighter, shorter ndolé. Blanched peanuts, ginger, garlic, Scotch bonnet and onions are blended with 2 cups of water, then poured into a pot with ground crayfish and another cup of water, covered, and simmered about 15 minutes with regular stirring so it does not burn. Sliced spinach and washed bitter leaf go in with salt, covered on low heat and stirred until the spinach has wilted properly. Prawns are fried on both sides and sliced onions fried separately, and both top the pot. The page links to a separate post for washing out the bitterness; that advice is not reproduced here.
steps: Peel the onions and garlic. Remove the stalk from the Scotch bonnet. Slice half of one onion and set it aside.
Blend the remaining onions with the peanuts, ginger, garlic and Scotch bonnet and 2 cups of water.
Fry the prawns on both sides until cooked, then fry the sliced onions and remove from the heat. (Frying times are not printed.)
Pour the blend into a pot, add the ground crayfish and a cup of water, cover and simmer about 15 minutes, stirring regularly to prevent burning.
Wash and slice the spinach and bitter leaf. Add them with salt, cover and cook on low heat, stirring until the spinach has wilted properly.
Top with the fried prawns and onions.
chefTips: The printed doneness cues are ‘cooked’ for the prawns and ‘wilted properly’ for the spinach.
Wash the bitter leaf as the author’s linked post advises if it is too bitter (the page does not give the method here).
commonMistakes: Skipping the stirring and letting the blended peanuts catch.
Adding the prawns to the pot before they are fried, as the method fries them separately.
Leaving the Scotch bonnet stalk on.
healthBenefits: Peanuts add protein and fat; spinach and bitter leaf add leafy greens.
culturalNote: This printing uses spinach and bitter leaf together and only 1 cup of peanuts. It is one of five ndolé printings in this collection; the ratios differ widely and are recorded unreconciled.
sources: Title as printed: ‘ndole (Cameroonian bitter leaf stew)’. Byline as printed: ‘Abi Olayiwola’. ‘Published: Jun 6, 2021’. Yield 4. Prep 10 min, cook 35 min (pass 1 only). TWO-PASS for ingredients and method (pass 2 near-verbatim).
PASS CONFLICT: pass 1 had ‘sauce is ready when it has darkened in colour’ and an ‘if too thick add 1 cup water’ line; neither appeared in the verbatim second pass, so neither is used here.
ABSENT, not estimated: prawn frying time; the method for washing out the bitterness (the page defers to another post); salt quantity.
